mechanism_narrative: The current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is always associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. Lower rates are interpreted as accommodative monetary policy, which supports equity valuations through lower discount rates and increased liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 4.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces liquidity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is rising and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it signals a dual threat of tightening monetary policy and inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises by >0.1% in 1 month and CPIAUCSL rises by >0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises by >0.1% in 1 month and CPIAUCSL rises by >0.2% in 1 month over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 > 13500), a rising CPI (CPIAUCSL > 0.2% increase in 1 month) signals inflationary pressures that lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as the Fed may tighten policy.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 13500 and CPIAUCSL rises by >0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 40% of instances where GDPC1 > 13500 and CPIAUCSL rises by >0.2% in 1 month over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The current level of unemployment rate (UNRATE) is always associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. High unemployment signals market anticipation of monetary policy easing, which supports equity valuations through lower discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE > 5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The current level of industrial production (INDPRO) is always associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. A decline in industrial output signals weakening economic activity, which leads to market pessimism and negative returns in the short term.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO < 100 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 7.8%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that triggers market expectations of monetary policy easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE > 7.8% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95, it signals a significant slowdown in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in recessionary risks.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO < 95 over a 3-year rolling window.
